notes:
Cold audit E2 (Opus, 2026-10-31). Accuracy: 25 sampled (random.seed(7), random.sample of harvest brands), 2 wrong (Payne Rod Company: name not on the category page, which lists James Arthur Payne; Simond: not on the cited first page of ispo.com/award-winner, found on ?start=60). Harvest is mostly Wikipedia category membership ('own article') = existence/cultural only; few entries state quality.
Raw fetches saved in verify/work/BRANDLAYER/AUDIT_E2_tmp/raw/*.json and parsed with python; no URLs constructed (Wikipedia article URLs taken from links on fetched category/navbox pages; ISPO pagination taken from page links).
Retry of thin areas (all from fetched pages): kendo bogu/shinai (Saitama makers, Takeya-ryu, Tokyo makers: added); Sialkot (ADB page, Anwar Khawaja: added; Capital Sports only in a TDAP PDF seen in search, not fetched); Meerut/Jalandhar (BDM, FC Sondhi); Kashmir willow (GR8 Sports, ICC-approved); Haudenosaunee sticks (Roundpoint factory, Traditional Lacrosse, Lewis Mitchell); Basque cesta/pelota (Chistera Gonzalez - French ICH inventory, Ona Pilota; Spanish-side makers unnamed); sumo (Sanpuku Shoji mawashi, maker's own page); pesapallo (Karhu already in harvest; Wikipedia confirms its pesapallo line - no other maker found); Muay Thai (Top King, Windy, Thaismai, Raja, Boon, Sandee); ISPO 2022 (GearJunkie) and 2025 (paged list); St Andrews (renown page + Auchterlonie).
Not found / out of scope: Korean gakgung (Yecheon), Mongolian and Turkish bows are BOWS = E4 (only thumb rings/quivers would be E2; no named E2 maker found). Kabaddi and kushti: no named gear maker on any fetched page (mats/langot are generic) - not an omission under REGIONS ARE NOT QUOTAS. Backpacker Editors' Choice and OutDoor Gold: no fetchable winners list surfaced (2024 ISPO summary page has no brand list). Stockli, Kastle, Zai, Honma: only the makers' own pages found - not recorded.
Seller-praise caveats: Eiko Budogu, Matsukan, Mitsuboshi (kendo) tier listed (kendo select-shop text); tt-spin.com may be shop-affiliated (table tennis entries cultural only); batterboxsports (Nokona 'only glove still handcrafted in the US') is a retailer so Nokona rests on Wikipedia.
Cross-category gaps: football boots, track spikes and balls are E2 by the category test, yet Asics, Umbro, Diadora, Joma, Kelme, Lotto, Hummel, Penalty, Topper, Uhlsport, Mitre, Zoggs sit in the register only under A1/A2. Added Kelme, Penalty, Uhlsport, Mitre, Zoggs with 'add E2' notes; the rest should get E2 by the merge rather than new rows.
Homonyms checked: Mikasa (volleyballs vs tableware), Puma (register also has a C1 Puma knives row - keep separate), Penn (tennis balls vs Penn Fishing reels), Head (two rows), Fischer (register E2 row is the fixings company - homonym error), Atomic, Salomon (fine), Cosco (no register row; COSCO shipping/Costco risk), Orme (Orme and Sons billiards, fine), Mitsuboshi (B5 cutlery vs kendo bogu), Select (F3 cards vs balls - register conflation), Faber (diving cylinders vs Quebec snowshoes), Topper (G1 dinghies vs Argentine sportswear), Victor/Viking/CORE (do not merge).
Main blind spots remaining: Sub-Saharan Africa and Central Asia (no named makers found - concentrated industry, not counted as omissions); Spanish Basque cesta makers unnamed; Korean/Chinese premium makers beyond table tennis and barbells; premium skis (Stockli/Kastle) lack independent pages here; surf hardware (Futures, Firewire, JS) and climbing hardware (Tenaya, Red Chili, Climbing Technology, Trango, Singing Rock) not swept; Irish dance shoes (Rutherford, Hullachan, Fays) not swept; Japanese hooks (Gamakatsu, Owner) not sourced.
